text:
Maya: small domestic emergency: foster kitten Nimbus discovered the full-length mirror and my parrot Miso (very chatty) thinks it's a new rival. photos: NIMBUS_MISO_1.jpg
Jon: confrontation of destiny :eyes:
Priya: oh nooo the crown feather puff :disappointed_relieved:
Maya: video incoming. Miso is lecturing the reflection and Nimbus is trying to pounce on the floorboard behind it.
Sam: must. have. video. :pray:
Maya: uploading `NIMBUS_MISO_reax.mp4` — 6s, 12MB
Alex: screenshots when? I need this for my "animals with existential crises" folder.
Priya: safety check: keep them separated during meals and at night. parrots can be territorial. also mirrors can confuse birds for a while.
Maya: thanks, will rotate mirror access and add a second small mirror for Miso so attention splits.
KitBot: reaction added :laughing: by Jon
Jon: vote time — what caption fits best? 1) "Mirror, mirror, who's the loudest of them all?" 2) "Tiny predator, giant opinions" 3) "When your roommate's reflection gets its own roommate"
Sam: 3 wins for me.
Alex: 2 for humor points.
Priya: also a suggestion: "Negotiations ongoing. Snacks promised."
Maya: poll posted: https://polls.example/animals/9932 — drop your vote :ballot_box:
Jon: also putting Nimbus on the next office morale slideshow :grin:
Maya: last upload before bed — Nimbus snoring into a toy: NIMBUS_SNOOZE.jpg :zzz:
Priya: swoon :heart_eyes:
Maya: ok we will try supervised mirror introductions for a few days. thank you team for the tips and the ridiculous captions. :cat::parrot:
